## Accepted full negative answer, attempt 1/5

AIM Problem 1.4, Shape optimization with surface interactions; corpus 20000488 / AIM-ANALYSIS-0020, rank 1269. The question is dimension-unrestricted. A genuine nonzero smooth compact graph in R4 at attractive Robin coupling beta=1 has spectrum [-1,infinity), disproving the universal claim of binding below the flat threshold. Both domain and boundary are connected.

The complete analytic report also proves all-coupling binding for every nontrivial connected smooth compact half-space perturbation in n=2,3, including overhangs and compact additional boundary components. In n>=4 every compact Lipschitz graph has weak-coupling absence below threshold. The essential-spectrum proof, form-core details, global boundary-defect identity, capacity test, self-contained Hardy–trace estimate, all-function bound and exact f=h/100 counterexample are retained in full.

The full dimension-unrestricted universal question is resolved negatively. No classification of arbitrary nongraph domains in n>=4, all-coupling absence, exclusion of embedded eigenvalues, or literature novelty is claimed. Exner–Minakov receive credit for the standard planar result; strong-coupling, magnetic-operator and historical talk statements retain their precise distinctions.

## Publication boundary and review limits

Exactly six authored proof/audit/status and public-source-metadata files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/20000488/`. The accepted proof already incorporates the closed-support-ball and weak-chain-rule corrections. All analytic proofs and the audit's authored symbolic arithmetic remain. Editorial changes remove private workflow provenance and supplemental program/output commentary, bind the audit to the exact distributed report, and reflect completed mathematical acceptance.

Programs, checker outputs, computational results, fixtures, datasets, copied third-party source bodies, source-derived images, and private coordination/version identities are excluded. No excluded computation is recast as prose. This edition is AI-assisted and unrefereed; scoped acceptance is not external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. Public source retrieval/inspection and manuscript status are recorded observations. Edition preparation makes no new scholarly retrieval, source-file rehash, source-inspection or literature-search claim.

QUEUE.md and unrelated entries are unchanged. Editorial preparation adds no substantive proof turn and does not reset accepted attempt 1/5. No merge, release, DOI or outside outreach is requested.
